notes.title: RedDeer.Games presents a new, cozy, puzzle game - Tell Me Your Story 📖
notes.content:
RedDeer.Games announces developement of a new in house game - Tell Me Your Story - proposition for every fan of story-driven, cozy & puzzle games! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/9740fd7b2d093f1a8556098e40c9e72dc7fbff67.jpg

Amelia comes to her grandma's cottage for the summer, expecting to spend the warm months there knitting, gardening, and helping her out. Soon enough, the girl realizes that her grandma Rose's house is full of wonders, artifacts, and souvenirs from all around the world. 

And so begins a journey to the past via the tales and memories of a retired globetrotter – a side of Amelia’s grandma, that she had no idea about.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/5a0570940adae65b57d63025550b2a9dbeed5c45.jpg

In Tell Me Your Story, the players, together with Amelia, will be tasked with helping the elderly woman with everyday chores – that is until they will find a couple of interesting artifacts. 

This discovery will turn the summer vacation around and Rose's adventurous past will be unearthed in the form of colorful memories.

To follow the story, the players will solve region-themed puzzles, surrounded by the hand-drawn scenery. There will be over 70 different types of riddles, neatly separated into 3 chapters related to Rose’s travels. Visiting South America's rainforests, the Chinese province of Yunnan, and the track of Orient Express' first route – that’s what players can expect.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/3f66393b0ce00aee6bc61123985dcbc72e205ea4.jpg

Tell Me Your Story has eye-catching and cozy visuals, that fit perfectly with the theme of getting to know the past of one's family. Those tales will be powered by Amelia's vivid imagination – which conveys the wordless game’s story perfectly.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/bdafd80507fdf0732489c23bdcd9e671afc91026.gif
Tell Me Your Story will be available on Steam and Nintendo Switch in 2024

You can wishlist the game now!

notes.title: New title from RedDeerGames! 7 Horizons is coming to Steam! Wishlist NOW!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37794046/186127bcf106c0d351f479795dbc29068e4a560b.png
A hero needed now - the adventure begins after the first shot!

Exciting platform challenges with shooter elements - all with a comic book atmosphere, humor, and beautiful hand-drawn graphics - that's 7 Horizons! 

Discover a cosmic world!

For thousands of years, the Six Worlds coexisted in harmony with each other. They were bound together by a mysterious energy, the Essence, which took a different form on each planet. 

However, the balance was disturbed by the arrival of Distortion, a mysterious creature the size of a globe, under whose influence the beings living in the Six Worlds began to change…

Rayman meets Mega Man!

You play as Jelly, who, as his name suggests, is a jelly that can change its shape. Thanks to this ability, you can take on the form and skills of people you meet. 

The game is maintained in a comic book style, which with the addition of a huge portion of humor, creates a world in which you will be a superhero in a cosmic epic!

In 7 Horizons you will visit many planets, each one providing a new experience with its unique mechanics and design.


So only one question remains - will you accept the challenge?

Visit 7 Horizons on Steam and add it to your Wishlist!

notes.title: It's official - we're making Cyber Protocol comics!
notes.content:
We're so excited to share this with you! 

We've been teasing this news on our social media for a few days now, but today we can officially confirm - we're in the process of developing a new story in the Cyber Protocol world in a form of comic, and thus opening up the universe to new possibilities! 

The dystopian world of CP has a huge potential for development and the story itself begs to be expanded and shown in more details! 

What does it mean that we open up the universe? In short, you can expect more stories in this world, so be sure to keep an eye on https://twitter.com/CyberProtocol77 and the news on steam, through which we will certainly keep you up to date! 

In the meantime take a look at the first sketches from the Cyber Protocol comic! Enjoy!

notes.title: CYBER BANK HAS JUST BEEN HACKED! - results of Cyber Protocol $1000 contest!
notes.content:
The old-school arcade game Cyber Protocol has never been so intense. In December, the best of the best compete with each other, battling through deadly levels and trying to get the highest high score—and $1000!

#HighScore in Cyber Protocol

This contest was inspired by the old days—like the whole game—where high scores actually mattered. We decided to bring back the tradition and reward the best players in the world with cash prizes.

To take part in the contest, you had to write on Twitter or Facebook a post “I’m competing for the #highScore in Cyber Protocol game” and play in the “TOP 20 Global Ranking” mode.

The competition ended on December 31, 2020 at 23:59 GMT.

Here is the list of winners:

1st place: VSIMCO ($1000)

2nd place: JENERGY ($200)

3rd place: HEIKAI ($100)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37794046/c8ce89e4d8a7f862806c965eef8ffdbb01a0bd4a.jpg

#unexpectedMessage

Although sinister corporations are relentless in their attempt to take total control of communications, we managed to contact the best player in the world!

We bring you the transcript of an interview with the winner of the #HighScore in Cyber Protocol contest.

BARTEK, REDDEERGAMES: How many hours have you played Cyber Protocol in total?

VSIMCO: This is actually a tough question to answer since I played the game on all the platforms it has released on (Xbox One, Switch, Steam). Xbox One ~ 50 hours (first version I played), Switch ~ 4 hours (have not beaten it yet), Steam ~ 460 hours (though I guess leaving arcade mode paused overnight would have that effect).

After such time you can probably judge it fairly. What do you think is the best thing about Cyber Protocol?

My favorite part of Cyber Protocol is definitely the interesting mazes – and finding the optimal path through those mazes. 

A lot of logical puzzles require mostly just a lot of thinking. Cyber Protocol adds the challenge of timing in combination with the logical deduction needed to solve the mazes which gives it a unique flare. 

There are similar games to Cyber Protocol out there – Cyber Protocol keeps things relatively simple for the player (you go up, down, right, left), the complexity and variation is all external  to the player and shows up in the puzzle itself – I liked that simplicity – you do not need anything external to the game itself to solve a puzzle. 

The combination of logical thinking, arcade timing, and no external knowledge needed are the best things about Cyber Protocol.  

Did you plan to win 1000$?

No. My goal for the Steam version was to be able to beat the game in less than <10 lives (23 lives for the winning run) – I did not achieve that goal – but will probably come back to the game. The longest I went without dying was actually around 50 stages.

Around December I thought I had a good chance of winning the competition so my focus went from not dying to finding consistent speed run paths through the game. Consistency is important in a run which is going to last 2-3 hours going through 100 levels where one small mistake could kill you – and using checkpoints takes up time which eats up your score. 

How will you spend 1000 dollars?

Upgrading my gaming setup.



Thanks again to all the participants. Follow our Twitter account @gamesreddeer to stay up to date with all the competitions!

notes.title: Cyber Protocol is NOW available on PC!
notes.content:

After a huge success at Nintendo Switch and Xbox One, RedDeerGames decided to bring Cyber Protocol, recently selected by Eurogamer as one of the best cyberpunk games, to PC. 

Become a hacker of the future and save your friend, the android G0X6. In order to bring G0X6 back to life, you need to hack through 100 handmade levels of the security system. The game presents a unique approach to the genre, mixing androids, holograms, and a city lit by colorful neon lights, with some really cool retro-elements.

1000$ FOR HIGH SCORE
RedDeerGames team decided to take us all back to the times when the high score was of the utmost importance for gamers and will reward the best achievements with cash prizes.

Don’t worry, you have a few weeks after the release date to train! The person at the top of the scoreboard on December 31st will be awarded 1000 dollars. Second and third places will get respectively 200 dollars and 100 dollars.

WIN PLAYSTATION 5
There’s even more! Everyone who purchases Cyber Protocol for PC, regardless of the score on the leaderboard, have a chance to win a PlayStation 5. Just share your first impressions of the game with us and use the hashtag #CyberProtocolWOW.

notes.title: Play Cyber ​​Protocol and win 1000 dollars
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37794046/cc09e26d909d5716b239258bbe1b1ef9cd410273.png
Netflix's series "High Score" reminded us of the times when the score in games was important and companies like SEGA paid for records. Creators of the retro cyberpunk game Cyber Protocol decided to the same thing today.  They will pay the person with high score 1000 dollars.

THE MOST DIFFICULT GAME OF ALL TIME
Cyber ​​Protocol is an insanely difficult arcade puzzle game with 100 hand-created levels and puzzles that are a real challenge even for hardcore gamers. The game takes us back to the time when skills, patience, and logic were the main requirements to beat challenges.

This is the toughest game in the world - at least according to the folks at RedDeerGames. Now you have a chance to prove them wrong and earn 1000 dollars in the process.

The game was released on Xbox One and Nintendo Switch. But only 0,7% of console players managed to finish the game and beat 100 levels.

HOW TO WIN 1000 DOLLARS
Now Cyber Protocol is making its way to PCs all around the world. To celebrate the upcoming PC release on September 17, 2020, the developers have prepared something special. They decided to take us all back to the times when high score used to be extremely really important for gamers and are going to reward the best achievements with cash prizes.

You have a few weeks after the release date to train. The person at the top of the scoreboard on December 31st  will win 1000 dollars. Second and third places will get another 200 dollars and 100 dollars.

How does it work? The PC version of the game features a special GLOBAL TOP20 mode: the challenges where players compete for real cash. More info will be revealed on September 17.
